title: Title sting
summary: A 5 s sting for any product name: wind streaks, a needle, the name sliced in, then a tagline.
structure: needle and wind streaks, the name slices in band by band, the tagline rises, one edge turns night to paper

inputs.label: Product name
inputs.where: h1.word in .lockup.night and in .lockup.paper (write it in both)

inputs.label: Tagline, word 1
inputs.where: first span of p.line in both lockups

inputs.label: Tagline, word 2
inputs.where: second span of p.line in both lockups

inputs.label: Tagline, word 3
inputs.where: third span of p.line in both lockups
